descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Fireball' Fireball Dwarf Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Fireball' is an interesting new red dwarf. It was found as a witches' broom near Cedarville, New Jersey, making this maple fairly cold tolerant. In the ground, 'Fireball' can withstand temperatures down to -15°F. In 15 years, this tree will reach 5 ft tall by 4 ft wide. Due to its small stature, this Japanese maple is ideal for fairy gardens, rail-road gardens, rock gardens, small conifer beds, and container planting. It leafs out a bright cherry red in the early spring, transforming to a deep maroon by mid-spring. All new growth on top is a bright cherry red overtop of this deep maroon. Some green-red tones appear by late spring, creating a wonderful contrast of colors. The name 'Fireball' is very fitting. In the fall, this Japanese maple will light up your yard when its leaves transform to a bright fire-engine red.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Fireball' 'Fireball' 矮生日本枫，适生分区 5-9。 'Fireball' 是一个很有意思的新型红叶矮生品种。 它是在新泽西州 Cedarville 附近发现的扫帚芽变，因此这株枫树具有相当不错的耐寒性。 地栽条件下，'Fireball' 可耐受低至 -15°F 的温度。 15 年内，这株树可长至 5 英尺高、4 英尺宽。 由于体型小巧，这个日本枫非常适合仙境花园、铁路模型花园、岩石园、小型针叶树花境以及容器栽培。 早春展叶时为明亮的樱桃红色，到春季中期转为深栗红色。 其顶部的新梢生长呈鲜亮的樱桃红，覆盖于深栗红底色之上。 到晚春时会出现一些红绿色调，形成极佳的色彩对比。 'Fireball' 这个名字十分贴切。 秋季时，这个日本枫的叶片会转为鲜亮的消防车红色，令庭院格外醒目。
